Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
CAMARILLA CONCLAVE 2018

Honorable Kindred of the civilised world:

In these exciting times for our lineage, we still have to face the constant attacks led by the other vampiric sects, who lust for the true power we wield. This fatal bleeding must be stopped at once. That is why the most exalted members of the Inner Circle of the Camarilla have decided to hold their Conclave on the 20th of October 2018 in Palma de Mallorca (Spain). Its main purpose will be the appointment of eight new Justicars (more capable than the current ones) to put an end to this situation that endangers our very existence.

We hope to see you all in Palma de Mallorca on the 20th of October, so that you can prove us you truly deserve the titles of Justicars.

Do not fail us, for the wrath of the Inner Circle will know no boundaries.

TOURNAMENT INFORMATION:

Event Date: 20th-October-2018
Event Location: Club Desperta Ferro (C. Armador Valentí, 23)
City: Palma de Mallorca
Country: Spain
Event Coordinators: Ginés Quiñonero (aka Damnans)
Oganizers: Club Desperta Ferro
Head Judge: Ginés Quiñonero
Multi-judge system: Yes
Format: Standard Constructed
# of rounds: 3+F
Time limit per round: 2 hours
Final round time limit: 2 hours
Start time: 10 a.m.
Entry fee: 6 euros

PRIZES AND PUNISHMENTS

Each player will receive one booster pack (randomly picked from various expansions) and a bunch of promo cards upon on site registration.

The available titles are:

-Assamite Justicar
-Brujah Justicar
-Gangrel Justicar
-Malkavian Justicar
-Nosferatu Justicar
-Toreador Justicar
-Tremere Justicar
-Ventrue Justicar

The 5 lowest seeded players will play an alternative final. The winner will be declared Anathema Maximum, and 2 other finalists will be randomly declared Anathema Maius and Anathema Magnum, respectively.

All of them will be awarded with 3D-printed deck boxes and blood pool counter boxes:

V:EKN Website Coordinator
